least:2.line: 'At *least* tell me you have a way out,' Ali said through the earpiece.

sentences.en: I had three routes into the signal tower.
sentences.cn: 我有三条进入信号塔的路线。

sentences.en: The longest was the safest.
sentences.cn: 最长的是最安全的。

sentences.en: The shortest was exposed and lit.
sentences.cn: 最短的是开阔且有光的。

sentences.en: The middle path was dark and unmapped.
sentences.cn: 中间的路暗得要命，没有人测绘过。

sentences.en: I chose the last one — not because it was easy, but because Zero would *least* expect anyone to come from a direction with no exit.

following:2.en: I found the note tucked inside a cracked junction box. It read: 'Do the *following* — go to level three, find the red cable, pull it twice.' Simple enough. Too simple. Grey Crow had taught me that clear instructions in this city always hid a harder test inside them.
following:2.cnHint: 我在接线盒里发现一张字条，要求我按照____的步骤行事，但灰鸦教过我别轻信简单指令。
following:2.hook: I pulled the cable twice — and the lights went out city-wide.
following:2.line: 'The *following* message was meant only for you,' Grey Crow said without looking up.

sentences.en: I found the note tucked inside a cracked junction box.
sentences.cn: 我在一个裂开的接线盒里找到了那张纸条。

sentences.en: It read: 'Do the *following* — go to level three, find the red cable, pull it twice.'
Simple enough.
sentences.cn: 很简单。

sentences.en: Too simple.
sentences.cn: 太简单了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had taught me that clear instructions in this city always hid a harder test inside them.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦教过我，这座城市里清晰的指令后面，总是藏着更难的考验。

decide:2.en: Ali and I stood at the split corridor under the old bridge. Left led to Zero's last signal point. Right led to the exit and safety. Grey Crow was not answering. We had to *decide* in seconds. The rain hammered the concrete above us. I looked at the left turn and exhaled.
decide:2.cnHint: 阿栗和我在地下走廊岔路口必须快速____：是追踪零点还是撤退。
decide:2.hook: I stepped left — and heard Zero's voice echo from the right.
decide:2.line: 'You have to *decide* now,' Ali said. 'He already knows we are here.'

sentences.en: Ali and I stood at the split corridor under the old bridge.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我站在老桥下的分岔走廊里。

sentences.en: Left led to Zero's last signal point.
sentences.cn: 左边通向零点最后的信号点。

sentences.en: Right led to the exit and safety.
sentences.cn: 右边通向出口和安全。

sentences.en: Grey Crow was not answering.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦没有回应。

sentences.en: We had to *decide* in seconds.
The rain hammered the concrete above us.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在我们上方的混凝土上。

sentences.en: I looked at the left turn and exhaled.
sentences.cn: 我看向左边的转角，吸了口气。
